title: Good
body: Good app. A bit complicated for my taste, but helps me being motivated
author: Ermurais

title: Annoying ads on the free version
body: Every time I start the app, I get an ad. Therefore I will stop using HabitBull.
author: Tudor C.

title: Are you serious?
body: Remove the very annoying transitions between the screen! We are not in PowerPoint presentation in the year 2003. I want a functional product and not something that distracts me from completing my task with stupid animations. Do you know any successful app that uses in your face transitions like that? No? Me neither. Also it’s not selfexplaining or even possible? To track bad habits
author: Der bartige Bärtmeister

title: Nice, but issues with profile, no support for new iPhone screen size
body:
In general, I like the app. However, it gets stuck when I want to register and there was an error when linking the app with your facebook profile.
In addition, the new screen sizes of iPhone X, Xr, Xs, 11 aren‘t supported. 
Otherwise, it would be a great app.
author: hoschitom

title: Super App
body:
Ich liebe diese App! 😍
Einziger Nachteil: alles in Englisch. Wäre super, wenn man die Sprache wählen könnte. Darum 'nur' 4 Sterne
